media_waveform_size.name: media_waveform_size
media_waveform_size.value: "media"."waveform" IS NULL OR cardinality("media"."waveform") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

messages_content.name: messages_content
messages_content.value: "messages"."deleted_for_everyone_at" IS NOT NULL OR "messages"."content_purged_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("messages"."kind" = 'text' AND ("messages"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "messages"."body_enc" IS NOT NULL)) OR ("messages"."kind" <> 'text' AND "messages"."media_id" IS NOT NULL)

messages_enc_has_version.name: messages_enc_has_version
messages_enc_has_version.value: "messages"."body_enc" IS NULL OR "messages"."key_version" IS NOT NULL

has_auth_method.name: has_auth_method
has_auth_method.value: "users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."google_id" IS NOT NULL
